svg.text: EVOLUTION · VISUAL-STYLE.md evidence — the eight player palettes (#34)

palette index 0–7 = seat order · six hues from concept sheet 01, Mint (5) and Rose (7) added so PLAYER_PALETTE_COUNT = MAX_PLAYERS_PER_GAME = 8 · seat mark = 1–8 rim beads anchored top-left · own cell: dashed SELF_RING at 1.12 r
separability: every base pair ΔE2000 ≥ 15 under normal vision; Rose ≥ 18 from all seven under normal, deutan and protan (qa/evidence/34/palette-separability.md)
swatches: base · rim · nucleus · edge (L 42 %) · cytoplasm light (L 55 %) · cytoplasm dark (L 22 %, S × 0.55) · nucleus dark (L 60 %) — derived from base in HSL, concept-art README sheet 01
MID LOD · 8–20 px on screen · halo, body, rim, outline, nucleus disc, seat marks (2 px bead floor) and the self ring survive; interior drops
FAR LOD · < 8 px · rim dot at the 3 px floor + halo, no interior, no seat mark: a presence tell, not an identity tell (the own cell never reaches this LOD in play)
